steps.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: replacement decorative immersive header for 知拍 photo specifications picker. Rework the supplied reference artwork into a NEW specification-themed composition; retain only its airy pale ice-blue and white palette, softly translucent material and restrained soft depth. This is not a photograph of a desktop and not a UI screenshot. Wide landscape 20:11 canvas, ideally 1800x990. Entire upper 55% is uninterrupted near-white cool blue (#F2F5FC) empty background for the phone status bar and navigation; this is within the artwork, no separate strip. In the lower 40%, a compact centered set of three slim upright white photo-specification cards in slightly different rectangular proportions, one very pale blue backing sheet; objects occupy only the central 60% of width, all fully visible. The cards contain tiny, low-contrast light blue generic head-and-shoulder profile silhouettes printed flat on white, no realistic faces, no black clothing, no heavy outlines. Very light blue-white frosted paper, precise clean edges, small subtle dimension corner marks as part of artwork but absolutely no letters or numbers. Modest depth and delicate directional shadows like the reference, with most pixels remaining very pale, no saturated large blue mass. The story is different photo dimensions, not people or a passport. No folder, notebook, passport booklet, flowers, props, stand, stage, dark blues, realistic portrait prints, badges, text, numerals, logo, watermark, bear mascot, QR code, or UI controls. Mature quiet native utility-app aesthetic; do not copy the reference layout. Bottom edge fades naturally into the same continuous near-white blue field.

Precise composition edit of this exact pale-blue specification illustration. Preserve its existing white/ice-blue colors, frosted paper material, three small silhouette cards and soft shadows. Make the entire card/backing-sheet/shadow group much more compact: scale the group to 65% of its present size and position it centered horizontally in the bottom third. The highest point of ANY object must be BELOW 60% of canvas height. Bottom of the group at 91% of canvas height, leaving a clear bottom margin. Upper 60% must contain only the same uninterrupted near-white blue background; that region will hold a phone status bar and navigation. No text, no numerals, no extra objects. Keep the full group visible, no cropping, no dark colors, no realistic portraits, no added icon. Preserve canvas aspect ratio.
